newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Opposition Bangladesh Nationslist Party (BNP) leader Begum Khaleda Zia said on Tuesday that the move to form the proposed four-nation sub-regional grouping was designed to make the SAARC ineffective and "establish Indian expansionism".
Bangladesh and Mayanmar began talks on Tuesday at the level of senior officials on repatriation of the Rohingya refugees.
The first base of para-military Bangladesh Coast Guard was opened in the port city of Chittagong.
A visiting U.S. academician of Indian origin Dr Sumuit Ganguly said in Dhaka on Tuesday that mistrust among member countries had made the cooperation difficult in SAARC.
Opposition leader and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia has demanded a proper inquiry into the recent scandal in the share market.

One of the highlights of British Prime Minister John Major's visit to Bangladesh early next week will be the signing of an agreement for commercial exploitation of a major off-shore gas field struck by a British firm.
